I don’t have direct access to your machine’s clock, so I can’t tell you the exact current time myself.  
If you’d like to see the time from the Windows command prompt, you can run one of the following:

```cmd
C:\> echo %TIME%
```

or

```cmd
C:\> time /t
```

Both will display the current system time. If you’re scripting this, you can capture the output into a variable or a file as needed.
